steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS1 USA SLUS01448; own CUE/disc, bundled OpenBIOS.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Local owned-input source route: use the documented developer setup psxrecomp_cli.py generate command on the owned SLUS01448 CUE, then CMake/Ninja psx-runtime. The README separately requires generatedC/stamps in currentmain for releaseCI; this is not mandatory preprovided payload when regenerating locally. Upstream release archives/OpenBIOS are described but not inspected or approved as managed packages.
